build_depth_decode_head: build a DepthBaseDecodeHead subclass to predict depth maps from multi-level image features
create_depth_prediction: create depth predictions from feature tensors using the depth_pred method with classify or regression mode
test_forward_train: test the forward_train method to compute depth losses given inputs and ground truth depth
review_losses_method: review the losses method to compute depth prediction loss against ground truth with configurable loss functions
summarize_log_images: summarize the log_images method that normalizes and returns RGB and depth visualization tensors
